P7432.corridor_notes: Source (taohuren.com, citing the 2011-11 project announcement) describes this as '宜兴支线' (the Yixing branch): '工程起点为金坛市薛埠镇...终点为我市高塍镇','高塍分输站'; route passes through '金坛市朱林、儒林以及我市新建、官林' (Zhulin & Rulin towns in Jintan, then Xinjian & Guanlin towns in Yixing). Length ~55km, diameter 610mm, ~3.2 billion RMB investment, construction started Nov 2011, adds 300 million m3/yr Sichuan-gas capacity to Yixing. Same article separately notes a later 'Jinwu pipeline phase 2' project through Heqiao and Wanshi towns (~33km) -- relevant context for P7558's 'Jinwu Pipeline' naming, but a distinct project, not part of this route. Xuebu Distribution Station is independently confirmed as a real hub on the Jiangsu trunk network -- it is also the named start of Section A of the 218km trunk (see P7542's ref, jsaeit.com), which corroborates Xuebu as a genuine branch point feeding multiple downstream lines including one toward Yixing.
P7432.researcher_notes: CAUTION - flag for human review: GEM lists this row's endpoints as StartLocation=Liyang / EndLocation=Yixing with LengthMergedKm=31.00 ('Liyi Branch, Liyang-Yixing'). The only sourced Yixing-directed branch found in Chinese-language search starts at Xuebu Town, Jintan (not Liyang) and is ~55km, not 31km. Xuebu (Jintan) is adjacent to/borders Liyang and both are under Changzhou prefecture, which may explain GEM's 'Liyang' simplification, but the length mismatch (55 vs 31km) is unresolved -- this could be (a) the same branch with GEM's length wrong/outdated, (b) GEM's 31km covering only part of the 55km branch, or (c) a genuinely different, unfound 'Liyi'-specific segment. No dedicated '溧宜' (Liyi) branch article was found despite multiple targeted searches; this is the best/only candidate located. Endpoint place names and coordinates are solid (verified station-level source); the PID-to-segment mapping is the open question.
P7432.blockers: Length discrepancy (source: ~55km; GEM: 31km) and start-city discrepancy (source: Xuebu/Jintan; GEM: Liyang) not resolved -- see researcher_notes. WebSearch tool budget for the session was exhausted (200/200) partway through this PID's research; remaining searches used DuckDuckGo/Sogou/Bing via WebFetch as a substitute, which is less reliable and CAPTCHA-prone, so a dedicated 溧宜-branch source may simply not have been found rather than not existing.

P7535.corridor_notes: Project name confirmed as '溧高管道工程' (Liyang-Gaochun pipeline project), part of '川气东送江苏配套管线一期工程' (Sichuan-East Jiangsu supporting pipeline phase 1) -- an EIA report with this exact title is catalogued on doc88.com (57pp PDF, uploaded 2014-12-26, paywalled, no free preview text). A Jiangsu provincial government land-use approval, '江苏省人民政府关于川气东送管道高淳分输站项目建设用地的批复' (苏政地[2015]24号, dated ~2015-04-09), confirms a '高淳分输站' (Gaochun distribution station) was built for this project, but the specific town/village within Gaochun District was not recoverable -- the hosting pages (lawlawing.com, wenku.baidu.com) were unreachable/blocked. A Pengpai/thepaper.cn retrospective article ('辉煌十年·看高淳') stated Gaochun connected to the Sichuan-East pipeline from Liyang in 2013 and began formal gas utilization in 2015, corroborating the general Liyang-to-Gaochun corridor and timeline, but that article has since been deleted (404 on both the desktop and mobile URLs, confirmed via direct fetch and via the r.jina.ai reader proxy) so it cannot serve as a citable ref.
P7535.researcher_notes: Corridor (Liyang -> Gaochun district) and project identity are well corroborated by multiple independent snippets, but no accessible source gave a station/township-level place name for either end that I could geocode and cite. No coordinates invented per standing instructions. A human with access to a paid doc88/docin account, or Jiangsu/Nanjing government EIA archives, could likely resolve this quickly -- the underlying documents clearly exist (EIA report + provincial land-use approval), they are just paywalled or unreachable through this session's tools.
P7535.blockers: No verifiable ref with station-level place names was found. Candidate documents identified but inaccessible: doc88.com/p-3127535294710.html (paywalled, generic metadata only, failed content check), lawlawing.com/community/157137 (ECONNREFUSED), wenku.baidu.com/view/24fe5e7ae618964bcf84b9d528ea81c758f52e02.html (HTTP 403), thepaper.cn article (deleted/404). WebSearch tool budget was exhausted (200/200) mid-session; remaining searches relied on DuckDuckGo (frequent CAPTCHA) and Sogou (frequent anti-spider block) via WebFetch, and archive.org's availability API was repeatedly rate-limited (429), likely from concurrent sibling research agents in this same batch hitting it simultaneously -- a retry with a clean web-search budget and without archive.org contention would likely resolve this PID.

P7542.corridor_notes: Official completion/acceptance notice (竣工环境保护验收调查报告公示, jsaeit.com, published 2022-10-17) for '"川气东送"江苏配套管线一期工程项目' states: '本项目主干线共分为三段，A段为薛埠分输站-镇江上党分输站，B段为镇江上党分输站-南京靖安分输站、C段为镇江上党分输站-江阴顾山分输站，管线总长度约为218km' (the trunk splits into 3 sections at 上党/Shangdang: A) Xuebu-Shangdang, B) Shangdang-Nanjing Jing'an, and C) Shangdang-Jiangyin Gushan; combined length ~218km). Design pressure 6.3MPa, diameter 813mm, operating pressure 4.0MPa, annual capacity 6.9 billion m3. This exactly matches GEM's LengthMergedKm (218.00) and segment label ('Jintan-Gushan trunk'), i.e. GEM's row corresponds to the combined A+C path via Shangdang (the B branch to Nanjing Jing'an is a separate spur, not part of this PID). A second independent source (Wuxi Municipal Public Utilities Group / wxszjt.com, via Wayback snapshot 2022-10-04, since the live page now 405s) corroborates the general entry-into-Jiangsu routing: '川气东送管道进入江苏后经金坛、镇江分输站一路至南京，一路向东经常州、江阴，接入无锡市' (after entering Jiangsu the pipeline runs via Jintan and Zhenjiang distribution stations toward Nanjing on one route, and east via Changzhou and Jiangyin to Wuxi on another) -- consistent with the Jintan (Xuebu) hub branching toward both Nanjing and Jiangyin/Wuxi.
P7542.researcher_notes: Strong 2-source corroboration and an exact length match (218km) to GEM's LengthMergedKm gives high confidence in both endpoint identity and the Xuebu/Jintan-to-Gushan/Jiangyin routing via the Shangdang (Zhenjiang) junction. Waypoint 镇江上党分输站 (Shangdang Distribution Station, Dantu District, Zhenjiang; Nominatim relation 19110648, 32.0739149/119.4144712) sits on the actual corridor and should be used as an intermediate vertex when drawing the candidate route, not a straight line.

P7548.corridor_notes: EIA report (南京国环环境科技发展股份有限公司, dated Feb 2013) for '川气东送江苏配套管线一期工程仪扬泰管道工程' (Jiangsu Natural Gas Co. Ltd, Sichuan-East Jiangsu supporting pipeline phase 1, Yiyangtai pipeline) states: '起自江苏省天然气公司仪征青山分输站...止于江都区丁沟分输站' (begins at Jiangsu Natural Gas Co.'s Qingshan Distribution Station in Yizheng, ends at Dingou Distribution Station in Jiangdu District). Total length ~94.9km -- an exact match to GEM's LengthMergedKm (94.90). Segment breakdown given in the source: Yizheng section ~35.5km, Yangzhou section ~30.3km, Jiangdu section ~29.1km (i.e. the route passes through Yizheng city, then Yangzhou proper, then Jiangdu district -- matching GEM's segment name 'Yiyangtai = Yizheng-Yangzhou-Jiangdu'). Main line 88.6km at D813mm/6.3MPa; a 6.3km D323.9mm branch also exists. Three distribution stations and eight isolation valve stations along the route.
P7548.researcher_notes: High confidence: exact length match (94.9km) to GEM plus a direct, unambiguous 起点/止点 (start/end) statement naming both distribution stations. This is the cleanest resolution of the five PIDs in this group.

P7558.corridor_notes: Wuxi Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources land-use approval notice (2017-09-18, referencing provincial approval 苏政地[2017]421号) for '川气东送管道金武管道—国信宜兴燃机热电联产天然气支线工程' (Sichuan-East pipeline, Jinwu Pipeline to Guoxin Yixing gas turbine CHP natural gas branch) confirms the branch terminates at the Guoxin Yixing plant site in '高塍镇徐家桥村' (Xujiaqiao Village, Gaocheng Town, Yixing) -- '高塍镇徐家桥村农用地0.8389公顷...转为建设用地'. This is the same Gaocheng Town host as P7432's Yixing-branch endpoint, consistent with Gaocheng being a hub area for Sichuan-East-sourced gas supply in eastern Yixing. Note: a separate, unrelated EIA (jshbgz.cn PDF, '江苏国信宜兴燃机热电联产工程专用输气管道项目') describes the SAME Guoxin Yixing plant receiving a different supply line from '西气东输宜兴分输站' (the West-East [Xinjiang-sourced] pipeline's own Yixing distribution station, near Dingshu Town) -- that is NOT this PID's line and was not used here, but explains why searches surface two distinct 'Guoxin Yixing gas line' EIAs (dual-sourced plant).
P7558.researcher_notes: END point is solid (government land-approval document, village-level, exact plant-site match). START point ('Jinwu Pipeline' per GEM) could not be pinned to a named tie-in station: a related but distinct EIA (czcdhb.com PDF, downloaded and pdftotext'd) describes a 'Jinwu line receiving gate station' (金武线接收门站) at Anwei Village, Xueyan Town, Wujin District, Changzhou (常州市武进区雪堰镇安圩村) -- but that document is explicitly a *downstream, Wujin-district* distribution project (medium-pressure mains to Wujin roads), not the Guoxin Yixing branch, so its station is very unlikely to be this PID's actual start (Xueyan/Wujin to Xujiaqiao/Yixing is a much longer distance than a 13km branch would cover). The taohuren.com source used for P7432 separately mentions a 'Jinwu pipeline phase 2' passing through Heqiao and Wanshi towns in Yixing (~33km) -- those Yixing towns are geographically much closer to Gaocheng/Xujiaqiao and are a more plausible source-side context for a short 13km branch, but no source directly ties a named station in Heqiao/Wanshi to this specific Guoxin branch. Left start uncoded rather than guessing.
P7558.blockers: Start/tie-in station for the 'Jinwu Pipeline' side not found in any accessible source. The bidcenter.com.cn EIA report that most directly matches this PID's exact project name ('金武管道—国信宜兴燃气热电联产天然气支线工程环境影响报告') was blocked by a human-verification wall on both direct fetch and the r.jina.ai reader proxy; a human researcher with a browser could likely retrieve it. WebSearch tool budget exhausted mid-session; remaining searches used DuckDuckGo/Sogou via WebFetch.
